folder_subtitle: Create a folder in the current location.
join_drive_subtitle: Paste the t.me invite link you received from a friend. If the drive has lots of history, joining may take a few seconds.
leave_drive_subtitle_named: Leave "{title}"? You can rejoin later with the invite link.
leave_drive_subtitle: You can rejoin later with the invite link.
logout_subtitle: Pick how much to clear from this device.
logout_soft_desc: Sign out but keep your local cache. Faster to re-login if it's still you.
logout_full_desc: Sign out everywhere and delete TDrive data on this device, including saved API credentials.
new_drive_subtitle: Friends can join your drive with the invite link you'll get next.
new_drive_approval_desc: People can request access with the link, but an admin must approve them.
share_subtitle_approval: People with this link can request access. An admin must approve them before they join.
share_subtitle_open: Anyone with this link can join the drive.
upload_title: How would you like to upload?
upload_plain_desc: Files are stored on Telegram as-is.
upload_encrypt_desc: TDrive encrypts file contents before sending them to Telegram. Names and folders stay visible.
import_extract_desc: Unpack archive contents into folders instead of uploading the archive file.
import_note_oversize_one: {count} file over {limit} will be skipped (Telegram's per-file limit).
import_note_oversize_other: {count} files over {limit} will be skipped (Telegram's per-file limit).
import_note_errors_one: {count} item could not be scanned and may be skipped or uploaded as-is.
import_note_errors_other: {count} items could not be scanned and may be skipped or uploaded as-is.
import_note_limit: Keep it under {max} items by removing generated/cache folders or splitting it into smaller batches.
bio_unsupported: Biometric unlock is not supported on this device. Your encryption password is always available.
bio_not_enrolled: Set up biometrics in your device settings, then reopen encryption settings.
bio_locked_out: Biometrics are temporarily locked. Unlock your device or use your encryption password.
bio_signing_required: Biometric unlock requires a signed TDrive build. Use your encryption password.
bio_invalidated: Biometric enrollment changed. Remove it and enable biometrics again with your encryption password.
bio_unavailable: Biometrics are unavailable right now. Your encryption password is always available.
enc_session_help: Files stay unlocked until you lock, sign out or close the app.
enc_setup_help: Use one password for every encrypted file in My Drive.
enc_setup_warning: If you forget it, encrypted files cannot be recovered.
enc_hint_placeholder: Optional hint (do not put the password here)
enc_hint_help: This hint is shown when TDrive asks for your encryption password. It is not encrypted, so don't put the password itself here.
enc_settings_subtitle: Manage your encryption password and optional unlock on this device.
enc_bio_enrolled: {method} unlock is enabled for this device. Your password remains available for recovery and other devices.
enc_bio_plain: Your encryption password unlocks encrypted files on this device.
enc_bio_enable_help: Enable {method} to unlock encrypted files for the current session. Keep your encryption password for recovery and other devices.
enc_bio_password_placeholder: Current password to enable on this device
failed_subtitle_partial: {failed} of {total} files didn't upload to {drive}. Files that uploaded won't be sent again.
failed_detail_indexing: Telegram accepted this file. It will appear after the next sync.
failed_detail_not_confirmed: Telegram may have accepted this file. Check the folder before uploading it again.
failed_detail_paused: Use this upload's Resume controls in Transfers.
failed_detail_retry_started: A retry was already started. Review its result in Transfers.
move_reason_same_folder: The items are already in this folder.
move_reason_into_self: You can't move a folder into itself.
